"""Expose disjoint walk buffers as restricted kernel parameters.

Only the packed walk changes. Initialization/reseed still use WalkParams.
The packed engine allocates disjoint x/y/prefix regions, separate live metadata,
and separate report buffers. Every walk access is redirected to the restricted
arguments, including the inlined selection helpers, so there is no second
unrestricted access path to a writable buffer.
"""
import re


FIELDS = {
    "x": ("unsigned", "stateX"),
    "y": ("unsigned", "stateY"),
    "pchain": ("unsigned", "statePrefix"),
    "dead": ("unsigned", "stateDead"),
    "hist": ("unsigned long long", "stateHistory"),
    "seed": ("const unsigned long long", "stateSeed"),
    "startIter": ("const unsigned long long", "stateStart"),
    "dp": ("DpRecord", "reports"),
    "dpCount": ("unsigned", "reportCounts"),
    "twConsts": ("const unsigned", "walkConstants"),
}


def patch(content):
    content = dict(content)
    path = "include/packedkernels.cuh"
    source = content[path]
    begin = source.index("__device__ __forceinline__ void tableSelectSlot(")
    end = source.index("#endif  // ECC_TABLE_FUSED", begin)
    body = source[begin:end]
    params = ", ".join(t + " *__restrict__ " + name for t, name in FIELDS.values())
    args = ", ".join(name for _, name in FIELDS.values())
    for helper in ("tableSelectSlot", "fusedSelect"):
        signature = helper + "(const WalkParams<unsigned> &p,"
        assert body.count(signature) == 1
        body = body.replace(signature, signature + " " + params + ",")
        body = body.replace(helper + "(p,", helper + "(p, " + args + ",")
    signature = "walk(WalkParams<unsigned> p, unsigned *denominators)"
    assert body.count(signature) == 2
    body = body.replace(signature, "walk(WalkParams<unsigned> p, " + params
                        + ", unsigned *__restrict__ denominators)")
    for field, (_, name) in FIELDS.items():
        body = re.sub(r"\bp\." + field + r"\b", name, body)
    assert not any(re.search(r"\bp\." + f + r"\b", body) for f in FIELDS)
    content[path] = source[:begin] + body + source[end:]
    path = "include/packedengine.cuh"
    old = "dynamicSharedBytes()>>>(P, denominators);"
    assert content[path].count(old) == 1
    content[path] = content[path].replace(old, "dynamicSharedBytes()>>>(P, "
        + ", ".join("P." + field for field in FIELDS) + ", denominators);")
    return content

"""Reduce a polynomial square in its packed even/odd coefficient streams.

For H=a^2 as an unreduced polynomial and B=a>>66, H>>131 = spread(B)<<1.
Conjugate the existing quotient/remainder circuit by this interleaving:
  E = B ^ B>>4 ^ B>>12 ^ B>>28 ^ B>>60
  O = B ^ E>>1 ^ E>>2
The quotient Q is spread(E) ^ (spread(O)<<1). All reduction work can then
stay in the two 65/66-bit streams until the final zip. Long division is the
independent oracle; no alternate walk or field polynomial is introduced.
"""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import random

MODULUS = 0xD1D0D000D0000000D000000000000000D


def spread(a):
    return sum(((a >> i) & 1) << (2*i) for i in range(a.bit_length()))


def reference(a):
    h = spread(a)
    while h.bit_length() > 131:
        h ^= MODULUS << (h.bit_length() - 132)
    return h


def packed(a):
    b = a >> 66
    e = b ^ (b >> 4) ^ (b >> 12) ^ (b >> 28) ^ (b >> 60)
    o = b ^ (e >> 1) ^ (e >> 2)
    te = e ^ (e << 1) ^ (o << 2)
    to = o ^ (o << 1) ^ (e << 1)
    ev = a ^ te ^ (e << 62)
    od = to ^ (o << 62)
    for s in (32, 48, 56, 60, 64):
        ev ^= te << s
        od ^= to << s
    return spread(ev & ((1 << 66) - 1)) ^ (spread(od & ((1 << 65) - 1)) << 1)


def check():
    rng = random.Random(220131)
    cases = [0, (1 << 131)-1] + [1 << i for i in range(131)]
    cases += [rng.getrandbits(131) for _ in range(10000)]
    for a in cases:
        assert packed(a) == reference(a), hex(a)
    return len(cases)


def shifted(prefix, shift, word, width):
    """32-bit word of a width-bit vector shifted left by shift (right if <0)."""
    parts = []
    for j in range((width + 31)//32):
        delta = 32*j + shift - 32*word
        n = min(32, width - 32*j)
        if delta >= 32 or delta + n <= 0:
            continue
        v = f'{prefix}{j}'
        parts.append(v if delta == 0 else f'({v} {"<<" if delta > 0 else ">>"} {abs(delta)})')
    return '(' + ' | '.join(parts) + ')' if parts else None


def generate():
    count = check()
    lines = ['// Generated by research/gen_square_reduce.py; inside eccPacked131.',
             f'// Checked against polynomial long division on {count} inputs.',
             '#pragma once', '#include "zip_square.h"',
             'ECC_HD P131 goal22SquareReduced(P131 a) {']
    for i in range(3):
        expr = f'(a.v[{i+2}] >> 2)'
        if i < 2:
            expr += f' | (a.v[{i+3}] << 30)'
        lines.append(f'    const uint32_t b{i} = {expr};')
    stages = [
        ('e', 65, [('b', 65, s) for s in (0, -4, -12, -28, -60)]),
        ('o', 65, [('b', 65, 0), ('e', 65, -1), ('e', 65, -2)]),
        ('te', 66, [('e', 65, 0), ('e', 65, 1), ('o', 65, 2)]),
        ('to', 65, [('o', 65, 0), ('o', 65, 1), ('e', 65, 1)]),
        ('ev', 66, [('te', 66, s) for s in (0, 32, 48, 56, 60, 64)] + [('e', 65, 62)]),
        ('od', 65, [('to', 65, s) for s in (0, 32, 48, 56, 60, 64)] + [('o', 65, 62)]),
    ]
    for prefix, width, terms in stages:
        for i in range(3):
            parts = [shifted(p, s, i, w) for p, w, s in terms]
            if prefix == 'ev':
                parts.insert(0, f'a.v[{i}]')
            expr = ' ^ '.join(p for p in parts if p)
            if i == 2:
                expr = '(' + expr + f') & {(1 << (width-64))-1}u'
            lines.append(f'    const uint32_t {prefix}{i} = {expr};')
    lines += ['    P131 out;',
              '    goal22Zip2(ev0, od0, &out.v[0], &out.v[1]);',
              '    goal22Zip2(ev1, od1, &out.v[2], &out.v[3]);',
              '    out.v[4] = (ev2 & 1u) | ((od2 & 1u) << 1) | ((ev2 & 2u) << 1);',
              '    return out;', '}']
    return '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'


def patch(source):
    start = source.index('ECC_HD P131 squarePolynomial131(P131 a) {')
    end = source.index('ECC_HD P131 sqr131(', start)
    return source[:start] + '#include "square_reduce.h"\n' + \
        'ECC_HD P131 squarePolynomial131(P131 a) { return goal22SquareReduced(a); }\n' + source[end:]


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.out.write_text(generate())
    print('PASS square reduction: 131 basis vectors, 2 edges and 10000 random values')
